title: Build: plateau + CSCV/PBO grading mode for exit_lever_ablation.py sweeps, so entry-parameter units can be auto-graded on regions and backtest-overfitting probability instead of 'any candidate passes'
note: Family: single-axis entry sweeps (A, docs/research/idea-family-review-2026-10-16.md). ~11 in-sample PASSes from ~40 selection units with no multiplicity correction; all 4 best-of-3 single-window PASSes failed fresh-window confirmation (winner's curse). P3's c56e units still grade 'PASS IF any candidate passes'. Outside: Bailey/Borwein/Lopez de Prado/Zhu 2017 (PBO via CSCV, https://papers.ssrn.com/abstract=2326253); White 2000 reality check; Hansen 2005 SPA; Harvey-Liu 2015 haircuts. FIRST STEP: --grade plateau (PASS iff >= K adjacent arms each pass the per-candidate test; arms ordered as given) and a pbo field computed from per-arm folds[].net_r (6 folds -> C(6,3)=20 splits). RQ-20261016-1fa6-05 is graded by hand until this lands.
